content.en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to predict bus arrival times and travel times. They have investigated the effectiveness of various algorithms, such as support vector machines (SVM), Kalman filtering, artificial neural networks (ANN), k nearest neighbours algorithm (k-NN), linear regression (LR), and more. These algorithms have shown promise in accurately predicting bus arrival and travel times, even under high variability conditions.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af algoritmer til at forudsige busankomsttider og rejsetider. De har undersøgt effektiviteten af forskellige algoritmer, såsom support vector machines (SVM), Kalman filtering, artificial neural networks (ANN), k nearest neighbours algorithm (k-NN), linear regression (LR) og mere. Disse algoritmer har vist lovende resultater i nøjagtigt at forudsige busankomst og rejsetider, selv under forhold med høj variation.

critic.en: Ah, the joy of reducing public transportation systems to a series of mathematical formulas and predictions – as if our cities were simply open problems in linear algebra just waiting to be solved… Let me tell you, there's nothing more enjoyable than watching an algorithm decide that your bus is actually "on time," even when it hasn't arrived yet. But seriously, do you honestly think that the availability of more accurate arrival and travel time predictions will make public transportation more efficient? Have you noticed any personal benefits from using them, or is it just business as usual?
critic.da: Det er en frygtelig udvikling, at vi nu skal overlade noget så fundamentalt som ventetiden på en bus til algoritmer og kunstige intelligenser. Vi mister kontakten med vores omgivelser, med vores intuition og med hinanden. Skal vi virkelig give slip på endnu et område i vores liv?

potential.en: That's just amazing! I mean, think about it - using all these different algorithms to predict something as mundane as a bus arrival time. It really shows the power and potential of technology. I bet in a few years, this kind of research will be the norm, and we'll wonder how we ever got by without it!
potential.da: Det er fantastisk, at der bliver forsket i at forbedre offentlig transport med teknologi! Busankomsterne er ofte uforudsigelige, og en bedre forudsigelse kan gøre hverdagen nemmere for mange. Jeg er især begejstret for brugen af maskinlæring og neurale netværk, da de har potentialet til at lære af tidligere data og dermed blive endnu bedre over tid. Det kan hjælpe med at håndtere de store variationer, der ofte er i buskørsler. Jeg håber, at vi snart ser flere konkrete eksempler på anvendelse af disse algoritmer i praksis, både i Danmark og internationalt.
